3D- product-presentations are more suitable than 2D- ones for products that are not easy to describe in text and images.
the usage of 2D- and 3D-product- presentations in e-commerce is not a matter of black and white but of gray.

the question of whether 3D-technology can be used to improve the usability of e-commerce websites.
the question, whether the use of 3D-products in e-commerce is beneficial for customers and companies.
the usability of 3D-web applications in e-commerce.
